Daily Logs (CSV Files) Available for Download

Retrosheet's core offering for download are event files which provide full play-by-play detail for games. These can be downloaded here. Box-score event files can also be downloaded at the same link

Retrosheet has also made more processed files available for download. These files take the form of a series of .csv files which summarize game-level data for all games for which Retrosheet has compiled information from 1897 - 2025.

The .csv files available for download are comprised of seven master .csv files. Clicking the links will download that file (except for 'plays' which will take you to the page to download 'plays' either by season or for all seasons).

  • allplayers.csv - contains basic information about all players divided by team-season
  • gameinfo.csv - contains game-level information such as teams, attendance, umpires, etc.
  • teamstats.csv - contains team-level statistics - line scores, lineups, and team statistics (batting, pitching, fielding)
  • batting.csv - batting statistics by player by game
  • pitching.csv - pitching statistics by player by game
  • fielding.csv - fielding statistics by player by position by game
  • plays.csv - parsed play-by-play data for all games for which Retrosheet has play-by-play data (including deduced event files)

These files are described in some more detail here.

A full set of these seven files which includes information on all games for which Retrosheet has compiled some information (1897 - 2025) can be downloaded here: Main CSV Download.

A simplified set of .csv files which only include 'stattype' = 'value' can be downloaded here: Simplified CSV Files.

A set of accompanying biographical files can be downloaded here: Biographical Files.

Game Set Collections

Retrosheet has compiled some additional game set collections. These collections are subsets of the simplified .csvs described above.

3+ Home Run Games (by an individual)
15+ Strikeouts (by an individual)
20+ Inning Games
20+ Runs Scored (by one team)
(Batting) Cycles
Interracial Exhibition Games (1925 - 1948)
No-Hitters
Triple Plays

It is always Retrosheet's intention that everything it offers for download (and displays on its website) is as correct as possible. The data offered for download here include no known errors. Nevertheless, this is a massive undertaking and the volume of data here is quite formidable. Please let me know if you find any errors or have any issues with any of the files.

Enjoy!

Tom Thress
